description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Awoken Darkness], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Red Wings of Baron Mode]

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Awoken Darkness
description.text: Darkness abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Red Wings of Baron Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed, critical chance =100%, Dark attacks deal 50% more damage
